report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Scientist position. We will not move forward with your application because your CV does not show the following required qualifications:

- 4 years of data science experience (only 1 year is mentioned)
- Understanding of Bayesian methods, time series analysis, or sensor signal processing
- Hands-on experience with probabilistic programming (e.g., Pyro, PyMC3)
- Experience with Amazon SageMaker (cloud platform)
- Experience with PySpark

These are all must-have requirements. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
